---
title: Settings reference
---

Every setting is available in the Garmin Connect app, Garmin Express, and on the watch
(hold the menu button on the watch face → **Watch Face** → **Customize**).
Colors set to **Auto (theme)** follow the selected color theme.

This page is generated from `tools/gen_settings.py`.

## General

Mode, theme and base colors.

| Key | Setting | Default | Options |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode` | Watch mode | Analog | Analog, Digital |
| `Theme` | Color theme | Classic | Custom, Classic, Racing, Ocean, Forest, Gold, Ice, Neon, Paper, Stealth, Tactical |
| `BgColor` | Custom background | Black | 28 colors |
| `PrimaryColor` | Custom primary | White | 28 colors |
| `SecondaryColor` | Custom secondary | Light gray | 28 colors |
| `AccentColor` | Custom accent | Orange | 28 colors |
| `SecondsMode` | Seconds | Awake only | Off, Awake only, Always (MIP) |
| `StatusIcons` | Status icons | on | on / off |

## Analog

Layout and hands.

| Key | Setting | Default | Options |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AnalogLayout` | Analog layout | Classic | Classic, Chronograph, Top + bottom, Minimal, Gauges, Pilot |
| `HourHand` | Hour hand | Baton | Baton, Dauphine, Sword, Leaf, Skeleton, Arrow, Needle, Rounded, Breguet |
| `MinuteHand` | Minute hand | Baton | Baton, Dauphine, Sword, Leaf, Skeleton, Arrow, Needle, Rounded, Breguet |
| `SecondHand` | Second hand | Lollipop | Needle, Lollipop, Counterweight, Arrow tip, Square tip |
| `HandSize` | Hand width | Regular | Slim, Regular, Bold |
| `HandLength` | Hand length | Regular | Short, Regular, Long |
| `HandOutline` | Hand outline | on | on / off |
| `CenterCap` | Center cap | Dot | None, Dot, Ring, Large |
| `HourHandColor` | Hour hand color | Auto (theme) | 28 colors + Auto |
| `MinuteHandColor` | Minute hand color | Auto (theme) | 28 colors + Auto |
| `SecondHandColor` | Second hand color | Auto (theme) | 28 colors + Auto |

## Dial

Ticks, numerals and ring.

| Key | Setting | Default | Options |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HourTicks` | Hour ticks | Bar | None, Line, Bar, Dot, Triangle, Double line, Diamond |
| `MinuteTicks` | Minute ticks | Line | None, Line, Dot, Railway |
| `TickLength` | Tick length | Medium | Small, Medium, Large |
| `QuarterEmphasis` | Emphasize 12/3/6/9 | on | on / off |
| `Numerals` | Numerals | None | None, Quarters, All, Roman quarters, Roman all, 12 only |
| `NumeralFont` | Numeral font | Condensed bold | System, Condensed bold, Roboto, Roboto black, Bionic, Serif, Condensed italic, Quartz LCD, Quartz outline, Quartz thin, Dot matrix, Pixel blocks, Dotted fine, Segment upright |
| `NumeralSize` | Numeral size | Medium | Small, Medium, Large |
| `DialRing` | Dial ring | None | None, Thin, Bezel, Double |
| `HourTickColor` | Hour tick color | Auto (theme) | 28 colors + Auto |
| `MinuteTickColor` | Minute tick color | Auto (theme) | 28 colors + Auto |
| `NumeralColor` | Numeral color | Auto (theme) | 28 colors + Auto |

## Digital

Time font and layout.

| Key | Setting | Default | Options |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DigitalLayout` | Digital layout | Classic | Classic, Stacked, Big, Sport, Minimal, Side |
| `TimeFont` | Time font | Condensed bold | System, Condensed bold, Roboto, Roboto black, Bionic, Serif, Condensed italic, Quartz LCD, Quartz outline, Quartz thin, Dot matrix, Pixel blocks, Dotted fine, Segment upright |
| `TimeSize` | Time size | Large | Small, Medium, Large, Extra large |
| `HourFormat` | Hour format | System | System, 12 hour, 24 hour |
| `LeadingZero` | Leading zero | off | on / off |
| `Separator` | Separator | Colon | Colon, None, Space |
| `Ghost` | Unlit segments / dots | on | on / off |
| `GhostColor` | Unlit color | Dark gray | 28 colors |
| `HourDigitColor` | Hours color | Auto (theme) | 28 colors + Auto |
| `MinuteDigitColor` | Minutes color | Auto (theme) | 28 colors + Auto |

## Data

Fields, gauges and date.

| Key | Setting | Default | Options |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Field1` | Field 1 | Date | Off, Date, Weekday + day, Battery %, Battery days, Steps, Heart rate, Calories, Distance, Floors, Active minutes, Body Battery, Stress, Notifications, Altitude, Temperature, Sunrise / sunset, Week number, Digital time, Seconds, Respiration, Recovery time, Day progress |
| `Field2` | Field 2 | Heart rate | Off, Date, Weekday + day, Battery %, Battery days, Steps, Heart rate, Calories, Distance, Floors, Active minutes, Body Battery, Stress, Notifications, Altitude, Temperature, Sunrise / sunset, Week number, Digital time, Seconds, Respiration, Recovery time, Day progress |
| `Field3` | Field 3 | Steps | Off, Date, Weekday + day, Battery %, Battery days, Steps, Heart rate, Calories, Distance, Floors, Active minutes, Body Battery, Stress, Notifications, Altitude, Temperature, Sunrise / sunset, Week number, Digital time, Seconds, Respiration, Recovery time, Day progress |
| `Field4` | Field 4 | Battery % | Off, Date, Weekday + day, Battery %, Battery days, Steps, Heart rate, Calories, Distance, Floors, Active minutes, Body Battery, Stress, Notifications, Altitude, Temperature, Sunrise / sunset, Week number, Digital time, Seconds, Respiration, Recovery time, Day progress |
| `FieldFont` | Field font | System | System, Condensed bold, Roboto, Roboto black, Bionic, Serif, Condensed italic, Quartz LCD, Quartz outline, Quartz thin, Dot matrix, Pixel blocks, Dotted fine, Segment upright |
| `FieldLabels` | Field labels | Text | None, Text |
| `FieldColor` | Field value color | Auto (theme) | 28 colors + Auto |
| `LabelColor` | Field label color | Auto (theme) | 28 colors + Auto |
| `GaugeLeft` | Left gauge | Off | Off, Battery, Steps goal, Body Battery, Stress, Active minutes goal, Floors goal, Seconds, Heart rate, Day progress |
| `GaugeRight` | Right gauge | Off | Off, Battery, Steps goal, Body Battery, Stress, Active minutes goal, Floors goal, Seconds, Heart rate, Day progress |
| `DateFormat` | Date format | FRI 9 | FRI 9, 9 OCT, FRI 9 OCT, 2026-10-09, 09.10, 10/09 |

## Always on

Always-on / low power display.

| Key | Setting | Default | Options |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AodStyle` | AOD style | Auto | Auto, Full face, Minimal, Minimal + date, Time only |
| `AodColor` | AOD color | Light gray | 28 colors |
| `AodFont` | AOD font | Same as time | Same as time, System, Condensed bold, Roboto, Roboto black, Bionic, Serif, Condensed italic, Quartz LCD, Quartz outline, Quartz thin, Dot matrix, Pixel blocks, Dotted fine, Segment upright |
| `AodOutline` | Outline hands / digits | on | on / off |
| `AodMarkers` | AOD markers | Quarters | None, Quarters, Hours |
| `AodShift` | Pixel shift | on | on / off |
